text:
mike: Heads up — PR #52431 ready for final review. Fixes fallback routing + kv-prefetch TTL. CI green. Need runtime + platform + security eyes before canary. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/52431 @linh @tara @oscar

tara: Quick skim — looks fine at a glance. Small concern: the auth header reorder might affect edge proxies. Can security confirm?

oscar: I can take the platform/ops side. Can you paste a tiny rollback/runbook snippet and the exact config flag names we should flip? Also, what canary window are we aiming for?

linh: I can look at runtime perf/eviction behavior. I'll run the local microbench and memory checks, ETA ~2-3h. What sequence length did you test with?

mike: Tested with seq=1024 and production-like batch mix. Perf delta ~+3% on p95 in my run. Runbook snippet below:

``
1) deploy canary to 10% in us-west
2) monitor kv_hit_rate, eviction_errors, and tail latency (p95)
3) if p95 > 200ms or eviction_errors spike, rollback to tag v52430
4) disable flag `--enable-prefetch-ttl` (default off) as emergency rollback
```

oscar: Good. Adding `--enable-prefetch-ttl` default=off for canary is best practice. I'll be canary owner if that works.

tara: Security note: @security-bot please run manual review on header reorder and secret-scan. The change touches token passthrough ordering.

security-bot: Auto-scan queued for PR 52431. No secrets detected in diffs. Flagging `authorization` header reorder for manual review. @linh or @mike please document the rationale for the reorder in the PR description.

linh: Rationale: moving the header parse earlier fixes a proxy-breaking case where some clients hit a 400 before headers were available. Added inline comment and a short paragraph in the PR describing the bug + repro. Will attach perf logs when bench finishes.

dev-bot: CI: all checks passed (unit, integration, lint). Canary schedule slot available tonight 22:00 PT.

oscar: I'll own the canary tonight. @mike please add me as `canary-owner` in the PR description and list the specific metrics (kv_hit_rate, p95, eviction_errors) to watch.

mike: Done — PR updated with canary owner, runbook snippet, and metrics to watch. @tara any final security thumbs?

tara: I'll do a manual pass in ~30m. If nothing blocking, security :+1:.

linh: All good from runtime after local bench — no memory regressions and behaviour looks stable. :rocket:

mike: Thanks all. Plan: wait for tara sign-off, then oscar to start canary at 22:00 PT. If no issues, promote to 100% by 04:00 PT. I'll merge after security thumbs and tag rollback plan in the PR. Closing thread after merge.
